speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing rectal bleeding and have felt a palpable mass in your rectal area. To better understand your condition, can you describe the characteristics of the bleeding, such as the color and whether it is mixed with the stool?

speaker: Patient
text: 45-year-old female. The patient reports a 2-week history of rectal bleeding occurring daily with bowel movements. She denies any pain with defecation and does not present with any other complaints.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Given your age and the daily bleeding without pain, have you noticed any unintended weight loss, fatigue, or changes in your bowel habits such as narrowing of the stool?

speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text: The lab results indicate your blood count and stool blood test are currently normal.
